events.text: Exit code is 1 in bash. The PowerShell runner is getting -1 because `$LASTEXITCODE` isn't set correctly when the process throws a native error and is caught by the try/catch. The fix: capture exit code *before* the try/catch affects it, or use a different approach for the exit-code test — run the process and check `$LASTEXITCODE` without catching:

The issue: when stderr output from a native exe is redirected via `2>&1` in PS 5.1, each stderr line becomes an `ErrorRecord`. The `try/catch` catches the exception thrown by the ErrorRecord, but `$LASTEXITCODE` is only set to the actual process exit code after the process completes — but in PS 5.1, a caught `NativeCommandError` resets `$LASTEXITCODE` to the internal error code (-1). The fix: don't redirect stderr at all for exit-code tests, just suppress the output:

arguments.new_string:
# ---- Error-exit test ----
    if (Test-Path $expectedExit) {
        $wantExit = (Get-Content $expectedExit -Raw).Trim()
        # Redirect stdout+stderr to null so PS 5.1 doesn't wrap stderr lines
        # in ErrorRecords (which corrupt $LASTEXITCODE via NativeCommandError).
        $null = cmd /c "`"$Binary`" `"$($jsx.FullName)`"" "2>nul"
        $gotExit  = $LASTEXITCODE

| Root cause | Fix |
|---|---|
| Lexer mode stack never pushed during tokenisation | Rewrote `tokenize()` to self-manage `JSXTag`/`JSXChildren` modes; push `JSXTag` after emitting `JSXLess` in JS mode |
| `/>` scanned as two tokens (`/` + `>`) | Fixed brace-depth tracking so `}` in JS-inside-JSX correctly pops back to `JSXTag`, letting `/>` be seen in JSXTag mode |

| `{ name }` emitted as `{ name: name }` | Param stored as raw string via `consumeDestructure`, re-emitted verbatim |
| `[ count, setCount ]` had extra spaces | `consumeDestructure` uses spaces only for `{` patterns, not `[` |
| `export { result }` emitted as `{ result: result }` | Added named-specifier branch to `parseExportDecl` + `genExportNamedDecl` |
| `export default Greeting` missing `;` | `genExportDefaultDecl` adds `;` for non-function declarations |
| `await` not parsed | Added `KW_await` to `parseUnaryExpr` |
| `var [a, b] =` rejected | `parseVarDecl` now calls `consumeDestructure` for `[` patterns |
| Error fixtures crashing PS `$LASTEXITCODE` | Exit-code tests run via `cmd /c ... 2>nul` to avoid PS 5.1 `NativeCommandError` |

time for stage 2/II

MVP Stage 2 — "Solid Tool"
After your basic transpiler works on single files, Stage 2 is about making it robust, usable, and fast without turning it into Babel.
1. Error Recovery & Diagnostics

    Don't crash on first error — resynchronize and report multiple errors per file
    Track source locations in AST nodes (line/column) for precise error pointing even without source maps
    Contextual error messages — "Expected > but found } — did you forget to close an attribute?"

2. Complete JSX Spec Coverage

    Member expression tags: <My.Component />, <context.Provider />
    Namespace tags: <svg:circle /> (if you care about SVG/mathML)
    Spread children: {...items} (rare but valid)
    Whitespace normalization in JSXText — collapse rules differ from HTML
    Comments inside JSX: {/* this */} properly stripped or preserved
    Boolean attributes: <input disabled /> → disabled: true

3. Configurable Output (via config.json or cmdline args)

    Pragma switching: React.createElement vs h() (Preact) vs _jsx (React 17+ automatic runtime)
    Development vs production flags: __source and __self props for React dev warnings
    JSX runtime import injection (React 17+ style: import { jsx } from 'react/jsx-runtime')

4. Performance & Architecture

    Arena allocator for AST nodes instead of individual new/delete or heavy smart pointer churn
    Zero-copy lexer — slice strings from source buffer instead of allocating
    Streaming/batch mode — transpile entire directories, not just stdin/single file
    CLI with flags: --pragma, --out-dir, --watch

5. Edge Case Hardening

    Unicode identifiers in tag names and attributes
    Complex expressions in attributes: <div attr={foo.bar[baz]()} />
    Nested ternaries with JSX: cond ? <A /> : <B /> (parser precedence handling)
    Adjacent JSX elements in expressions: (<></>) fragments wrapping siblings

Stage 2 Time Estimate
+2–3 weeks on top of MVP.
